edition.locus: Documenta Catholica Omnia Canones GR (sources/canones_GR.pdf), p. 2, Canon θ´

source_text: Τοὺς δὲ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ εὑρόντας τι ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἑαυτῶν οἰκίαις, καταλειφθὲν ὑπὸ τῶν βαρβάρων, ἐὰν μὲν κατηγορηθέντες ἐλεγχθῶσιν, ὁμοίως ἐν τοῖς ὑποπίπτουσιν, ἐὰν δὲ ἑαυτοὺς ἐξείπωσι καὶ ἀποδῶσι, καὶ τῆς εὐχῆς ἀξιῶσαι.
thought_title: Keeping what the invaders left behind
orientation: Penance for keeping what the invaders left behind: if convicted, they are placed among the kneelers; if they confess and give it back, they are admitted to the prayer.
pass_a_gloss: Those who found something in the field or in their own houses, left behind by the barbarians, if being accused they are convicted, likewise among those falling under; but if they declare themselves and give back, [it is fitting] to count [them] worthy even of the prayer.

choices.why: A ruling parallel to δεῖ, not a permission; 'may' would weaken the modality.

pass_b_english: As for those who found something in the field or in their own houses that the barbarians had left behind: if they are accused and convicted, they too are to be among the kneelers; but if they confess on their own and give it back, they are to be admitted even to the prayer.
notes: Rubric left out (editorial). The clauses are elliptical: the verb for the first ('are to be') is understood from section 8, and ἀξιῶσαι depends on an understood 'one should' (hence 'are to be admitted', not the weaker 'may'). ἐν τοῖς ὑποπίπτουσιν = among the kneelers (penitential grade, section 11); ὁμοίως rendered 'they too' (likewise, as in section 8). τῆς εὐχῆς = the prayer of the faithful, the standing-together grade; καί = 'even'. No corrections; no Scripture.

changes: modality: 'they may be admitted' → 'they are to be admitted' (ἀξιῶσαι is a ruling, parallel to δεῖ, not a permission)
